scope: Predeclared 144 search/48 audit split of saved development objects; frozen searches and refinement, audit never used to select; no outer test
rules: Strictly lower cost and same exact prediction guard; deletions and cheaper one-for-one exchanges, descending saving/removed/added order; best evaluated feasible cost then loss then indices; restart after acceptance; total 200 candidate requests per variant, including repeated/cache-hit requests
fairness: Identical refinement cap, not equal total initial search work or runtime
holdout_rule: seed20260930+1000*dataset_index+repeat; permute192 positions, first144 search, last48 audit; search-fold validation blocks are three consecutive48 blocks; audit does not change full-set internal bound
